archetypes.name: workflow-state
archetypes.rationale: Diff relocates FINALIZE and SIMPLE sentinel writes across a multi-step orchestrator state machine where ordering mistakes can break later reads or completion markers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the /design control-flow changes around Step 2a, Step 2a.5, Step 3b, Step 4, and Gate C. Verify that every fresh-run and short-circuit path reaches FINALIZE before Step 4 reads rejected-findings artifacts, and that completion markers are written only after prerequisite artifacts succeed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: resume-compat
archetypes.rationale: The change adds legacy paused-session compatibility paths that interact with save/load sentinels and could regress resumed runs without failing normal fresh-run checks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on pause/resume compatibility for old SIMPLE sessions with step-2a but not step-2a.5, and old sessions with step-3b but not finalize. Check whether the new guards repair only the intended legacy states and avoid re-running or corrupting artifacts on HARD or degraded paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-guards
archetypes.rationale: The diff introduces embedded Bash and structural harness logic where rc capture, set -e behavior, quoting, and regex guards are easy to get subtly wrong.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the embedded Bash fences and shell harness additions for robust error handling, quoting, temp-file cleanup, rc propagation, and bash version portability. Pay particular attention to set +e/set -e transitions, branch-scoped sentinel writes, awk/grep route guards, and whether assertions can produce false positives or false negatives. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: contract-sync
archetypes.rationale: The implementation updates a normative workflow contract spread across SKILL.md, reference docs, script docs, and harness pins, so drift between surfaces is a specialized risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the relocated FINALIZE and SIMPLE-sentinel contracts across SKILL.md, approval-gates, flags, plan-review, sketch-launch, script docs, and configuration docs. Verify that all normative prose, operator breadcrumbs, and harness needles describe the same routing and caller ownership without stale Step 3b-to-Step 4 bypass language. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
